usage: e.g. /decide this email is spam: Win a free iPhone by clicking here
/decide <question> | opt1, opt2, opt3 [:: text] → picks one option
e.g. /decide what to have for dinner | pizza, sushi, salad :: I'm broke and in a hurry
/decide score <criterion> | level0, level1, ... :: text → score from 0 to N
e.g. /decide score urgency | low, medium, high :: the server just went down
Send a photo with the caption /decide ... to evaluate the image.

decidir.description: Probability, choice or score with OpenAI Decisions
decidir.usage_arg: <statement>[: text] | <question> | opt1, opt2 | score <criterion> | n0, n1 :: text
decidir.not_configured: Decisions is not configured (it needs an OpenAI key: DECISIONS_API_KEY).
